verdict.rationale: Building and sharing custom assistants is a fair question for a consumer AI assistant, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions creating custom agents or GPT-like assistants with their own instructions and knowledge, or sharing them. Memory (storing user facts) and connectors (linking OneDrive or Gmail) are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can build and share custom assistants with their own instructions and knowledge
